It is Fabulous. Why I never thought to look for this before is beyond me…but it is absolutely fabulous. I just couldn’t get over it. And how about it totaled up my groceries when I was finished shopping and on my way to the register, it rounded up my total including taxes, ex. $116, and my receipt was something like $115 and some change.
It’s the best thing ever, no more note pads & pen and trying to remember the quantity.. it just put my list in the app and when I get to the store I just add the cost & put in the quantity and the app totals it up as you go along & when you’re finished shopping it gives you your final bill. Easy and wonderful. • Real-Time Syncing: Share and update grocery lists with family or roommates across multiple devices.
• Pantry Inventory: Track what you already have at home to avoid duplicate purchases.
• Barcode Scanning & Receipt Tracking: Quickly add items and monitor spending.
• Custom Categories: Organize lists by store layout or personal preferences.
• Push Notifications: Get alerts when someone updates a shared list or enters a store.
• Mr. Listo Mascot: A quirky animated buddy to help check off items.


👍 Pros

• Easy to use and visually clean interface.
• Great for organizing multiple lists (e.g., different stores or events).
• Predictive text and memory of past items/prices streamline list creation.
• Budgeting tools help manage grocery expenses.
• Free version is robust, Pro unlocks unlimited lists and removes ads A B C.


👎 Cons

• Syncing issues reported by some users, especially with pantry lists.
• Deleted categories may reappear unexpectedly.
• Limited customization for preset categories.
• Occasional app crashes when categorizing certain items.
• Customer support response time can be slow A B.


🧾 Final Thoughts

List Ease is a powerful and user-friendly grocery list app that shines in collaborative shopping and organization. While syncing bugs and category quirks may frustrate some users, its overall functionality and thoughtful features make it a top pick for household planning. If you shop across multiple stores or manage shared responsibilities, List Ease is worth a try.

Helpful for Staying within budget. What I love about this app is the feature where not only your list total is shown, but also your running cart total as you check items off the list. It is also very helpful that you can add your local sales tax rate and that automatically applies to the total. This app has been very helpful to stay within budget while grocery shopping. 

As a person who loves good user experience, I think a few things could be improved. For example, sharing lists is a very weird experience. I tried sharing lists and have zero insight into whether the individuals joined the list, or are even still part of the list. Do they see all of my lists or only a single list? There is zero visibility here. Also just some other simple list management features would be helpful such as being able to sort the order of how lists appear in the dropdown menu. Currently it just seems like the lists appear based on the last creation date rather than alphabetical order or the order I want. This would be helpful. In my case I actually maintain two or more lists per store I shop at, one to maintain a list of Supply items that I often purchase from that store and a second list for Buy items. I will usually move items from Supply to Buy to build a list for the next store visit. This helps me maintain a running list total but still manage to build a list of items I only need to purchase the next or current visit. My experience cresting new lists is just the lists don’t appear next to each other in the list even if the same spelling. 

Finally, a CSV import and export feature would be nice for those of us who like to use spreadsheets. We could build a list quickly on the desktop spreadsheet and be able to import it into ListEase rather than finger typing a long list of items. More efficient especially if we wanted to scan or input a receipt to build a CSV list and then import that list into ListEase. 

Ultimately I love the simplicity of it, shows a list of items, a total, and a running cart total.
